rv.q: The audience was captivated and the play received a justly awarded standing ovation.
With direction from Mojisola Kareem, this is a compelling revival of Wole Soyinka’s dense and satisfying drama
The role demands humour, drama, anger, which Ojo carries off perfectly.
A truly important and powerful production.

I did enjoy the performance, it's probably worth noting that some of the important nuances in the tale can be lost if your ear isn't used to some of the accents – and that for me, was a real shame as I believe it detracted from the overall experience.
